validation.empty_file: Invalid file: the uploaded CSV is empty.
validation.max_rows: Invalid file: it contains {rows:,} rows. The upload limit is 10,000 rows.
validation.same_columns: Column error: choose different columns for the date and sales value.
validation.invalid_group: Column error: the grouping column must differ from the date and value columns.
validation.invalid_date: Invalid date in column '{date_col}' (for example, row {row}). Use day/month/year or year-month-day, and ensure dates are not blank.
validation.invalid_value: Value column '{target_col}' contains non-numeric text (for example, '{value}' in row {row}). Remove currency symbols and Excel errors before uploading.
validation.insufficient_rows: Not enough historical data: {rows} rows found. At least 30 rows are needed to detect a sales pattern.
validation.constant_values: Forecast cannot be created: all historical values in '{target_col}' are identical. Review the value column.
validation.insufficient_group_rows: Not enough data: every branch or group needs at least 15 historical rows.
